description: Author-only newest-first listing of a report's archived version history. Each entry summarises what changed (sections edited, etc.) so the workspace UI can render a clickable history without loading every artifact. Pair with `get_report_version` to fetch a specific version's content for diffing against HEAD. Any plan; only the report's author gets rows.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous response's `next_cursor` — the smallest version number on the previous page. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of archived versions to return (1–100). Defaults to 20.

report_id.description: Identifier of the report whose version history to list, as returned by create_report or list_my_reports.

name: list_report_versions

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

title: List Report Versions
